answer: Start with Stamped pharmacy licence with pharmacy regulator attestation. The idea is simple: a licence the regulator renews after dispensing audits, and that thread alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence the regulator renews after dispensing audits — so privacy survives, and the lantern is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the anchor for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
